reason: Prioritize tail_alignment because its guarded full-vector stores address a concrete bounds and predicate cost concern while preserving the transpose layout and GEMM. The main-512 unroll and general K unroll are plausible low-risk loop changes that preserve FP32 order, but remain unmeasured. Pointer splitting and scheduling proposals also keep the arithmetic path, though the prior pointer trials were mixed and the tile-reuse trial regressed sharply; those joint outcomes do not isolate causes. Codegen inspection could identify a real issue before editing. Transpose/layout and packing proposals touch more memory behavior, introduce allocation or layout risk, and have no direct supporting measurement. Streaming-region fusion ranks last given complexity and prior severe regression without causal evidence.
